courses.title: Iyengar Yoga for Back Problems
courses.description: A weekly Thursday-morning Iyengar yoga class for new and existing students who have back problems, taught by Andrew Hall with other teachers from the school assisting. It runs for most of the year at the school in Acocks Green, Birmingham, on a drop-in basis.

left_out: Jayne Orton's work with a football club's injured players (teachers page): a biographical mention, not an item.
flags: Iyengar Yoga for Back Problems: the page calls it 'a Therapy class for new or existing students with serious or non-specific back problems'.
